subject: PE
title: PE 1
description: PE 1 builds fundamental movement skills through play: moving safely in space, locomotor skills (hop, gallop, jog, slide, skip), balancing and rolling, throwing, catching, kicking, striking, dribbling, jumping rope and dancing. Children learn how exercise affects the heart, muscles and bones, track simple fitness measures, and practice cooperation and sportsmanship, finishing with a family field day.
framework: California Physical Education Model Content Standards; 2009 CA Physical Education Framework

standards.PE-1.1.1: Balance on one, two, three, four, and five body parts.
standards.PE-1.1.2: Balance while walking forward and sideways on a narrow, elevated surface.
standards.PE-1.1.3: Demonstrate the relationship of under, over, behind, next to, through, right, left, up, down, forward, backward, and in front of using the body and an object.
standards.PE-1.1.4: Create a routine that includes two types of body rolls (log roll, egg roll, rocking-chair roll) and a stationary balance position.
standards.PE-1.1.5: Hop, gallop, jog, and slide using a mature motor pattern.
standards.PE-1.1.6: Jump continuously with a self-turned rope and jump a long rope turned by others.
standards.PE-1.1.7: Toss and throw a ball underhand and overhand toward a target, stepping with the opposite foot.
standards.PE-1.1.8: Catch a gently tossed or bounced ball using the hands.
standards.PE-1.1.9: Kick a stationary and a slowly rolling ball using the inside of the foot.
standards.PE-1.1.10: Strike a balloon or ball upward and forward with the hand or a short-handled paddle.
standards.PE-1.1.11: Dribble a ball continuously with one hand while stationary and moving.
standards.PE-1.1.12: Perform simple rhythmic movement and dance sequences to music.
standards.PE-1.2.1: Explain the difference between pathways (straight, curved, zigzag), levels (high, medium, low), and personal vs. general space.
standards.PE-1.2.2: Describe the critical elements (cues) of the hop, gallop, jog, and slide.
standards.PE-1.2.3: Explain the critical elements of throwing, catching, and kicking (e.g., step with the opposite foot, watch the ball).
standards.PE-1.3.1: Participate in physical activities that are enjoyable and challenging.
standards.PE-1.3.2: Participate in moderate to vigorous physical activity for increasing periods of time.
standards.PE-1.3.3: Demonstrate muscular strength and endurance activities (e.g., modified push-ups, curl-ups, hanging).
standards.PE-1.3.4: Demonstrate flexibility exercises for major muscle groups.
standards.PE-1.3.5: Walk and jog for increasing distances to build aerobic capacity.
standards.PE-1.4.1: Recognize that physical activity makes the heart beat faster and identify the location of the heart.
standards.PE-1.4.2: Explain that the body needs water, healthy food, and rest to be active.
standards.PE-1.4.3: Identify that muscles move bones and that physical activity makes muscles and bones stronger.
standards.PE-1.4.4: Explain why warming up and stretching prepare the body for activity.
standards.PE-1.5.1: Work cooperatively with a partner or small group and share equipment.
standards.PE-1.5.2: Follow rules and safety procedures and take turns during physical activity.
standards.PE-1.5.3: Give positive encouragement to others and accept feedback.
standards.PE-1.5.4: Identify feelings that result from participation in physical activity.

units.title: Safe Movement: Space, Pathways and Levels
units.big_idea: Moving safely means knowing your space and your body.

units.title: Locomotor Skills
units.big_idea: Hopping, galloping, jogging and sliding each have a special pattern.

units.title: Balance, Rolling and Tumbling
units.big_idea: A strong center and wide base help us balance and roll safely.

units.title: Fitness and My Body
units.big_idea: Exercise makes my heart, muscles and bones strong.

units.title: Throwing and Catching
units.big_idea: Step with the opposite foot to throw; watch the ball into your hands to catch.

units.title: Kicking, Striking and Dribbling
units.big_idea: Controlled force and focus help us send a ball where we want.

units.title: Jump Rope, Rhythm and Dance
units.big_idea: Moving to a beat builds coordination and joy.

units.title: Cooperative Games and Teamwork
units.big_idea: Games are more fun when we follow rules, take turns and encourage others.

units.title: Fitness Check and Field Day
units.big_idea: We celebrate how much stronger and more skillful we have become.

objectives: Move safely in personal and general space

days.title: Space bubble
days.work: Warm up with arm circles, then stand in a hula hoop 'bubble' and explore reaching high, low and wide without leaving it.

days.title: General space
days.work: Walk, then jog, around cones in the yard without touching cones or people; freeze on 'Stop'.

days.title: Stop and go
days.work: Play red light/green light focusing on safe stops.

days.title: Safety rules
days.work: Make 3 PE safety rules (stay in your space, listen for stop, take care of equipment) and practice them in a tag game.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Show personal vs. general space on command and explain why a warm-up comes first.

weeks.assessment: Teacher observation of safe stopping and spacing.

objectives: Travel in different pathways

days.title: Chalk paths
days.work: Draw straight, curved and zigzag chalk paths and walk, skip and jog along each.

days.title: Follow the leader
days.work: Follow a family member's pathway around the yard, then lead.

days.title: Letter paths
days.work: Walk the pathway of your name's letters.

days.title: Obstacle path
days.work: Run an obstacle course with all three pathways.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Name and demonstrate each pathway on command.

objectives: Move at high, medium and low levels
Move forward, backward, sideways

days.title: Levels freeze
days.work: Move to music and freeze at the level called (high, medium, low).

days.title: Scarf toss
days.work: Toss a scarf high and catch it at a low level.

days.title: Directions
days.work: Walk forward, backward and sideways safely in a game of 'Simon Says'.

days.title: Combination
days.work: Gallop forward at a medium level, crab-walk backward at a low level.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform a 4-move sequence with two levels and two directions.

objectives: Use over, under, through, around with objects

days.title: Obstacle words
days.work: Build an obstacle course: crawl under a table, step over a broomstick, through a hoop, around a chair.

days.title: Position game
days.work: Place a beanbag or ball where called (behind, in front, next to you).

days.title: Partner mirror
days.work: Mirror a partner's movement on the left and right.

days.title: Course redesign
days.work: Design and run your own obstacle course using 6 position words.

days.title: Unit 1 check
days.work: Run the course while calling out each position word.

objectives: Jog with arms bent
Gallop with the same foot leading

days.title: Jog form
days.work: Jog with bent arms swinging front to back; jog 3 laps around the yard.

days.title: Gallop
days.work: Gallop like a horse with one foot leading, then switch leads.

days.title: Gallop relay
days.work: Gallop to a cone and back; switch leads at the cone.

days.title: Music moves
days.work: Jog and gallop to music, changing on the beat.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Show a gallop with both lead feet and say the cues.

objectives: Hop on one foot with balance

days.title: Hop cues
days.work: Hop on right foot 5 times, then left foot, landing softly.

days.title: Hopscotch
days.work: Play hopscotch, tossing a beanbag into squares.

days.title: Hop patterns
days.work: Hop in a pattern: right-right-left-left.

days.title: Hop and go
days.work: Hop across lily-pad spots drawn in chalk.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Hop 10 times on each foot in a row.

objectives: Slide sideways
Try the step-hop of the skip

days.title: Slide
days.work: Slide sideways leading with one side, then the other, between two cones.

days.title: Slide tag
days.work: Play slide tag along a chalk line: everyone may only slide sideways, and the tagger switches each round.

days.title: Step-hop
days.work: Practice step-hop slowly, then faster as a skip.

days.title: Locomotor music
days.work: Change locomotor skill each time the music stops.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Demonstrate slide and step-hop; encourage a family member.

objectives: Combine locomotor skills

days.title: Circuit
days.work: Do a 4-station circuit: jog, hop, gallop, slide for 1 minute each.

days.title: Animal moves
days.work: Move like animals using locomotor skills (bunny hop, horse gallop, crab slide).

days.title: Locomotor tag
days.work: Play tag where the tagger calls the movement.

days.title: Partner feedback
days.work: Watch a family member gallop and give one cue as feedback.

days.title: Unit 2 check
days.work: Skill check of hop, gallop, jog and slide using cue checklist.

objectives: Balance on 1–5 body parts

days.title: Body part balances
days.work: Balance on 2 feet, 1 foot, 2 hands and 1 foot, then 5 body parts.

days.title: Statue game
days.work: Freeze in a balance when music stops.

days.title: Partner balance
days.work: Create a balance with a partner touching hands.

days.title: Hold it
days.work: Hold three balances for 5 seconds each.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Show balances on 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 body parts.

objectives: Walk forward and sideways on a narrow elevated surface
materials: 2x4 board on the ground or a curb

days.title: Line walk
days.work: Walk forward on a tape line with arms out, eyes forward.

days.title: Board walk
days.work: Walk forward on a 2x4 board laid on the ground.

days.title: Sideways
days.work: Walk sideways along the board with feet stepping together-apart, arms out, eyes on the far end.

days.title: Challenge
days.work: Carry a beanbag on your head while walking the board.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Walk the board forward and sideways without stepping off.

objectives: Perform log roll, egg roll and rocking chair roll

days.title: Log roll
days.work: Roll sideways with arms overhead like a log.

days.title: Egg roll
days.work: Tuck knees and roll sideways like an egg.

days.title: Rocking chair
days.work: Rock on a rounded back with chin tucked.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Practice each roll 5 times safely.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Demonstrate two rolls with control.

objectives: Create a routine with two rolls and a balance

days.title: Plan
days.work: Choose two rolls and one balance for your routine.

days.title: Practice
days.work: Practice transitions between moves.

days.title: Add beginning and end
days.work: Start and finish with a still shape.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Practice the routine 5 times, holding the balance for a 5-count each time.

days.title: Unit 3 check
days.work: Perform the routine for family.

objectives: Locate the heart and feel it beat faster with exercise

days.title: Find your heart
days.work: Place a hand on your chest to find your heart; listen with a paper-tube stethoscope.

days.title: Before and after
days.work: Feel heartbeat at rest, then after 1 minute of jumping jacks; compare.

days.title: Heart-pumping game
days.work: Play freeze tag for 10 minutes.

days.title: Heart chart
days.work: Draw a heart and list activities that make it pump.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Explain why the heart beats faster when we move.

objectives: Do strength activities
Explain that muscles move bones

days.title: Muscles move bones
days.work: Feel your arm muscle when you bend your elbow.

days.title: Animal strength
days.work: Do bear crawls, crab walks and frog jumps.

days.title: Modified push-ups
days.work: Practice knee push-ups and curl-ups.

days.title: Hang
days.work: Hang from monkey bars for as long as possible.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Record push-ups, curl-ups and hang time.

objectives: Perform stretches
Explain why we warm up

days.title: Warm-up
days.work: Do a 3-minute warm-up of jogging in place and arm circles.

days.title: Stretch
days.work: Learn 5 stretches (butterfly, toe touch, cat-cow, arm cross, side reach).

days.title: Kids yoga
days.work: Do a GoNoodle or kids yoga video.

days.title: Sit and reach
days.work: Measure sit-and-reach with a ruler.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Lead a warm-up and stretch for family.

objectives: Walk/jog for longer distances
Explain the body needs water, food and rest

days.title: Walk-jog
days.work: Walk-jog for 8 minutes around a park.

days.title: Fuel
days.work: Discuss foods that give energy and why water matters during activity.

days.title: Longer jog
days.work: Walk-jog for 10 minutes, taking water breaks.

days.title: Rest
days.work: Discuss why sleep helps muscles grow.

days.title: Unit 4 check
days.work: Fitness journal: record jog time, push-ups and stretch.

objectives: Toss underhand to a target

days.title: Toss cues
days.work: Learn cues: swing back, step with the opposite foot, release, follow through.

days.title: Target toss
days.work: Toss beanbags into a basket from 6 feet.

days.title: Distance challenge
days.work: Move back after 3 successful tosses.

days.title: Partner toss
days.work: Toss underhand to a partner's ready hands from 8 feet, taking a step back after every 3 good tosses.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make 10 underhand tosses at the basket from 8 feet and record how many land in.

objectives: Catch with hands, watching the ball

days.title: Scarf catch
days.work: Toss and catch a scarf with two hands.

days.title: Beach ball catch
days.work: Catch a beach ball tossed by a partner.

days.title: Bounce catch
days.work: Catch a ball after one bounce.

days.title: Catch challenge
days.work: Count how many catches in a row you and a partner can make from 6 feet; try to beat your record 3 times.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Catch at least 5 of 10 gentle tosses with hands only (no trapping against the body).

objectives: Throw overhand stepping with the opposite foot

days.title: Throw cues
days.work: Learn: side to target, arm back, step opposite, throw.

days.title: Wall target
days.work: Throw at a chalk target on a wall.

days.title: Knock down
days.work: Throw to knock down plastic cups.

days.title: Partner practice
days.work: Throw and catch with a partner, sharing the ball.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Throw overhand with cues 5 times.

objectives: Apply throwing and catching in games

days.title: Hot potato
days.work: Pass quickly around a circle with family.

days.title: Monster ball
days.work: Throw balls to push a big ball across a line.

days.title: Catch count
days.work: Partner catch with step back after each success.

days.title: Ball relay
days.work: Run a throw-and-run relay: throw overhand at a cone, run to get the ball, and hand it to the next player.

days.title: Unit 5 check
days.work: Skill check of toss, throw and catch.

objectives: Kick with the inside of the foot

days.title: Kick cues
days.work: Learn plant foot beside ball, kick with inside of foot.

days.title: Target kick
days.work: Kick into a cone goal from 10 feet.

days.title: Distance kick
days.work: Kick a stationary ball for distance 3 times and mark the best kick with a cone.

days.title: Partner pass
days.work: Pass the ball back and forth with a partner 10 feet apart using the inside of the foot; count passes.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: 10 kicks at target; count goals.

weeks.topic: Kicking a rolling ball and dribbling with feet
objectives: Kick a slowly rolling ball
Dribble with feet

days.title: Trap and kick
days.work: Stop a rolling ball with your foot, then kick.

days.title: Rolling kick
days.work: Kick a ball rolled by a partner.

days.title: Foot dribble
days.work: Dribble with soft touches around cones.

days.title: Mini game
days.work: Play 5 minutes of 1-on-1 soccer with a family member using small cone goals and soft kicks.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Kick a ball rolled slowly toward you 5 times, aiming at a cone goal.

objectives: Strike a balloon or ball upward
materials: paper-plate paddles (plate taped to a craft stick)

days.title: Balloon tap
days.work: Keep a balloon in the air using open hands, then only one hand, then elbows; count taps.

days.title: Make a paddle
days.work: Tape a paper plate to a paint stirrer or ruler to make a paddle and decorate it.

days.title: Paddle tap
days.work: Tap the balloon up with the paddle; count taps.

days.title: Partner volley
days.work: Hit the balloon back and forth.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Count consecutive balloon taps with the paddle and record your best of 3 tries.

objectives: Dribble a ball with one hand

days.title: Bounce and catch
days.work: Bounce and catch a ball with two hands.

days.title: One-hand dribble
days.work: Dribble with fingertip pushes, stationary.

days.title: Walk and dribble
days.work: Dribble while walking along a straight chalk line, then a curved one.

days.title: Dribble tag
days.work: Play dribble tag: everyone dribbles while trying to tag others without losing their ball.

days.title: Unit 6 check
days.work: Skill check of kick, strike and dribble.

objectives: Jump and land softly
Jump a long rope

days.title: Jump and land
days.work: Jump forward and land softly on two feet.

days.title: Snake rope
days.work: Jump over a wiggling 'snake' rope on the ground.

days.title: Long rope
days.work: Jump a long rope turned by two family members.

days.title: Rhyme
days.work: Jump to 'Teddy Bear, Teddy Bear' rhyme.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Count your best number of long-rope jumps in a row out of 3 tries.

objectives: Jump a self-turned rope

days.title: Rope sizing
days.work: Size the rope; practice turning and stepping over.

days.title: Jump and turn
days.work: Turn, stop, jump (one at a time).

days.title: Continuous
days.work: Try continuous jumps with a single bounce per turn; count your best streak.

days.title: Feelings
days.work: Talk about feeling frustrated and proud while learning.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Count consecutive self-turned jumps.

objectives: Move to a beat in a dance sequence

days.title: Beat moves
days.work: Clap and step side-to-side to the beat of a song, then march and clap together.

days.title: Folk dance
days.work: Learn the Hokey Pokey and Chicken Dance.

days.title: GoNoodle
days.work: Follow a GoNoodle dance video, then do it again with bigger, cleaner moves.

days.title: Create
days.work: Create an 8-count dance with 4 different moves (step, clap, turn, jump).

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Perform your 8-count dance 4 times in a row to music.

weeks.topic: Dance creation and jump rope show
objectives: Combine dance and jump rope

days.title: Dance sequence
days.work: Build a 16-count dance from favorite moves.

days.title: Rope tricks
days.work: Practice jumping fast and slow.

days.title: Rehearse
days.work: Rehearse the 16-count dance and a 20-second jump-rope routine together.

days.title: Show
days.work: Perform the dance and jump-rope show for family, ending with a bow.

days.title: Unit 7 check
days.work: Reflect on feelings and skill growth.

objectives: Follow game rules and take turns

days.title: Duck duck goose
days.work: Play with family and practice turns.

days.title: Simon says
days.work: Play Simon Says with locomotor and balance commands, then lead a round.

days.title: Four square intro
days.work: Learn four-square rules with chalk squares and play a slow-bounce version.

days.title: Make rules
days.work: Invent a backyard game with 3 rules and one safety rule; write or draw them.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Teach and play your invented game with family, enforcing the rules fairly.

objectives: Work with a partner to achieve a goal

days.title: Towel toss
days.work: Toss a ball with a towel held by two people.

days.title: Balloon partners
days.work: Keep a balloon up with a partner, alternating taps; count your team record.

days.title: Wheelbarrow
days.work: Wheelbarrow walk 10 feet with a partner holding your ankles, then switch.

days.title: Encourage
days.work: Practice encouraging words during games.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Partner challenge with cooperation.

objectives: Show good sportsmanship

days.title: Parachute games
days.work: Play parachute (bedsheet) popcorn.

days.title: Capture the flag
days.work: Play simplified capture the flag with two teams and a sock 'flag' in each yard half.

days.title: Good sport
days.work: Practice ending every game with a high five and 'good game,' and name one thing the other player did well.

days.title: Feelings
days.work: Talk about feelings when you win and lose.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Self-rate sportsmanship (rules, turns, kind words) on a 3-face scale and set one goal.

objectives: Play traditional games safely

days.title: Tag games
days.work: Play freeze tag and shadow tag.

days.title: Hopscotch
days.work: Draw a hopscotch board and play with family, hopping on one foot in single squares.

days.title: Kickball
days.work: Play mini kickball with 3 bases, kicking a rolled ball and running the bases.

days.title: Playground
days.work: Visit a playground and practice safe play.

days.title: Unit 8 check
days.work: Lead a family game teaching rules.

objectives: Compare fitness to start of year

days.title: Strength check
days.work: Record push-ups, curl-ups, hang time.

days.title: Endurance check
days.work: Walk-jog for 10 minutes; record laps.

days.title: Flexibility check
days.work: Measure sit-and-reach with a ruler after a warm-up and record it.

days.title: Compare
days.work: Compare this week's push-ups, hang, sit-and-reach and jog laps with your week 14 records.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Set a summer fitness goal (e.g., hang 20 seconds) and write 2 ways to practice.

objectives: Review all skills

days.title: Locomotor review
days.work: Circuit of hop, gallop, slide, skip.

days.title: Throw and catch
days.work: Throw overhand and catch with a partner from 10 feet, saying the cues aloud.

days.title: Kick and dribble
days.work: Kick at target; dribble around cones.

days.title: Station day
days.work: Rotate through 5 stations (hop, balance beam, throw, kick, dribble) for 3 minutes each.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Do a skill checklist with a parent for hop, gallop, throw, catch, kick and dribble.

objectives: Plan field day events

days.title: Plan events
days.work: Choose 5 field-day events and draw a poster for each.

days.title: Sack race
days.work: Practice pillowcase sack race.

days.title: Egg and spoon
days.work: Practice an egg-and-spoon race with a plastic egg, walking a 15-foot course.

days.title: Relay
days.work: Practice a hop-gallop-slide relay with a baton handoff.

days.title: Review & check
days.work: Make a field day schedule with event times and invite family.

objectives: Participate in field day with sportsmanship

days.title: Field day 1
days.work: Run the pillowcase sack race and the locomotor relay, cheering for others.

days.title: Field day 2
days.work: Compete in the beanbag toss and a family kickball game.

days.title: Field day 3
days.work: Obstacle course and tug-of-war.

days.title: Awards
days.work: Make awards for effort and encouragement.

days.title: Reflect
days.work: Share favorite activity and feelings.
